title: Valle d'Aosta Regional Right-to-Study Scholarships (VDA1 & VDA2)
official_title: Bando di concorso per l'attribuzione di assegni di studio e contributi alloggio a favore di studenti iscritti a corsi universitari presso Atenei valdostani
university: Università della Valle d'Aosta; Conservatoire de la Vallée d'Aoste; Corso di Infermieristica UniTo Aosta
citizenship_restrictions: Open to Italian, EU, and non-EU international students
academic_requirements: Enrollment in eligible programme at Valle d'Aosta institutions; first-year students apply on income only (merit checked ex-post); subsequent years require CFU credits
language_requirements: Italian (programme-dependent); no separate language certificate required for DSU application
income_requirements: VDA1: ISEE ≤ €28,339.88, ISPE ≤ €61,608.48; VDA2: ISEE ≤ €44,968 (no ISPE limit)
asset_requirements: ISPE as above; foreign assets assessed via ISEE Parificato
enrollment_requirements: Must complete enrolment by 31 March 2027; provisional ranking check required
merit_requirements: First year: ex-post (20 CFU by 10 Aug 2027); Subsequent years: varies by year/programme per bando
additional_benefits: Regional tax refund (€140); international mobility supplement (€600/month up to 10 months)
official_source: Regione Autonoma Valle d'Aosta - Istruzione e Diritto allo Studio
required_documents: ISEE Universitario or ISEE Parificato (family abroad) via authorised CAF
selection_process: Ranking by ISEE (lowest first); provisional ranking published; appeals within deadline; final ranking determines winners and eligible non-winners
renewal_conditions: Reapply each year; must meet merit requirements for previous year (20 CFU for first-year by 10 Aug; subsequent years per bando)
compatibility_rules: Incompatible with MAECI scholarships, other regional DSU, university merit awards; must choose one within 10 days of latest award
eligibility: Non-EU international students with valid residence permit
Enrolled in Bachelor's, Master's, or Single-cycle Master's at Valle d'Aosta institutions
Not holding degree of same/higher level
Not receiving other public scholarship for same year
benefits: Monetary grant (varies by ISEE band and status: in sede/pendolare/fuori sede)
Free accommodation in regional residences (if available)
Free daily meal(s) at university canteen
requirements: Valid ISEE Universitario or ISEE Parificato
Enrollment at eligible institution by deadline
Completion of online application on regional portal
documents: Property ownership docs 31 Dec 2025 (for ISEE Parificato)
english_requirement: Not required for DSU application; programme-dependent
application_method: Register on Regione Valle d'Aosta portal (SPID/CIE or temporary credentials for non-residents)
Check provisional ranking and submit appeals if needed
Provide Italian IBAN and PEC for payments
selection_notes: Ranking by ISEE (lower = better). Budget determines number of winners; eligible non-winners receive services only (meals, tuition exemption, tax refund) but no cash grant.
best_fit: International students enrolling at Valle d'Aosta universities (UniVdA, Conservatoire, Nursing) who meet ISEE thresholds. Only OPEN regional DSU call as of Nov 2026.
notes: Two tracks: VDA1 (standard DSU thresholds) and VDA2 (higher ISEE, no ISPE, no tuition coverage). Non-resident international students without SPID/CIE receive temporary credentials. International students classified as fuori sede unless family resides in Italy. First instalment ~Nov 2026; balance after merit verification Aug/Nov 2027.
verification_notes: Official call published on regione.vda.it; deadline 4 Dec 2026 12:00 confirmed; two bands VDA1 (ISEE≤28,339.88, ISPE≤61,608.48) and VDA2 (ISEE≤44,968, no ISPE); international students without SPID/CIE get temporary credentials; only OPEN regional DSU call in Italy as of 18 Nov 2026

applicant_utility.isee_parificato_timeline: Start 6-8 weeks before deadline; CAF processing + legalisation can take 4-8 weeks
applicant_utility.fuori_sede_proof: Registered rental contract ≥10 months (Sep-Jul), rent ≥€150/mo, within km limit of campus

title: Politecnico di Torino PhD Scholarships — 42nd Cycle, 3rd Session
official_title: Call for applications for admissions to the PhD programmes of Politecnico di Torino for the 42nd cycle — 3rd session
eligible_programmes: Design and Technology. People, Environments and Systems
citizenship_restrictions: Open to Italian and foreign citizens without nationality restrictions
academic_requirements: Master's degree (Laurea Magistrale), Specialist degree (Laurea Specialistica), or pre-reform degree qualifying for PhD admission; or equivalent foreign qualification obtained by 31 Oct 2026
language_requirements: English proficiency (programme-dependent; typically TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent); Italian not required for most programmes
enrollment_requirements: Must hold qualifying degree by 31 Oct 2026; enrollment after selection by PoliTo deadlines
merit_requirements: Selection by evaluation of qualifications, research proposal, and/or interview per programme; annual renewal contingent on completion of previous year's activities
additional_benefits: Research budget (10% of grant = €1,885.45/year); 50% stipend increase for research abroad (up to 12 months, 18 for cotutelle); tuition waiver (regional tax €140/year due); INPS separate management (2/3 university, 1/3 recipient)

funding_details.conditions: Merit-based selection; annual renewal; 36 months max
funding_details.abroad_increase: 50% for up to 12 months (18 for cotutelle)

required_documents: Language proficiency certificates (English, Italian if required)
Declaration of Value / Diploma Supplement for foreign degrees
selection_process: Evaluation of qualifications (CV, degrees, publications) + research proposal + interview (varies by programme); ranking per programme; minimum 110 funded positions across all 3 sessions
renewal_conditions: Annual renewal contingent on completion of previous year's research activities and admission to next year by Academic Board; maximum 36 months
compatibility_rules: Incompatible with: other Italian PhD scholarships; public employee special leave with salary; apprenticeship contracts; research fellowships; research positions (Art. 22-ter L. 240/2010); DSU scholarships; MAECI
eligibility: Italian and foreign citizens (no nationality restrictions)
Master's degree or equivalent foreign qualification by 31 Oct 2026
Not holding another Italian PhD scholarship
Not a public employee on special leave with salary
Not a research fellow or holder of Art. 22-ter research position
benefits: 50% stipend increase for research periods abroad (up to 12 months, 18 for cotutelle)
Tuition fee waiver (regional tax €140/year still due)
Exempt from IRPEF and local income tax
documents: Declaration of Value / Diploma Supplement (foreign degrees)
english_requirement: Required per programme (typically TOEFL iBT ≥90, IELTS ≥6.5, or equivalent); some programmes may accept Italian
application_method: Select PhD programme and session (3rd session: 14 Jan – 15 Feb 2027)
If selected: accept position and complete enrollment
Activate Italian residence permit (non-EU) within 8 days of arrival
Provide Italian IBAN for stipend payments
selection_notes: Minimum 110 funded positions across 3 sessions for 42nd cycle. Selection by programme committee. Reserved positions for foreign government scholarships, POLITO FOR REFUGEES, CONFLICT ZONES. Gross annual amount set by Ministerial Decree 247/2022.
best_fit: International PhD candidates in engineering, science, architecture, design, management. Fully funded 3-year position with research budget and abroad mobility. Application opens 14 Jan 2027.
notes: 3rd session of 42nd cycle. Programme starts 1 June 2027. Part of minimum 110 funded positions across all sessions. Some programmes have inter-university agreements (Bioengineering with UniTo, Urban Development with UniTo, Electronics with INFN). Check programme tables for specific research topics and available positions.
verification_notes: Official call published on polito.it; 3rd session dates confirmed: opens 14 Jan 2027, closes 15 Feb 2027 14:00 CET; €18,854.52/year gross per Ministerial Decree 247/2022; research budget 10%; 50% abroad increase; tuition waiver (€140 regional tax due); incompatible with other PhD scholarships/DSU/MAECI

applicant_utility.preparation_timeline: Prepare research proposal and documents Nov–Dec 2026; language certificates early; reference letters in advance
applicant_utility.foreign_degree_process: Declaration of Value from Italian Embassy/Consulate + Diploma Supplement recommended; start early

fields_not_confirmed: Exact positions per programme for 3rd session
